name: Feast Of The Passover The
overview: The Feast of the Passover, as outlined in Scripture, is a divinely appointed observance commencing on the fourteenth day of the first month at evening, marked by specific rites and ceremonies (Numbers 9:3). It involves the offering of a lamb without blemish, accompanied by a wave offering of the firstfruits, signifying dedication to the LORD (Leviticus 23:11-12). The feast also establishes a lasting statute forbidding the consumption of bread or grain products until the offering is made, underscoring the solemnity and sanctity of this holy convocation (Leviticus 23:14). These instructions emphasize the Passover's role in commemorating Israel's deliverance and foreshadow redemption through Christ.
